bugs.name: Pickup availability descriptions run two sentences together without a space
bugs.summary: Pickup availability descriptions run two sentences together without a space
bugs.expected: Each sentence in the Pickup availability descriptions is separated by a space after the period (for example, “...pickup point. Ordered products...” ).
bugs.actual: The Local stock only and All warehouses descriptions display “...pickup point.Ordered products...” with no space after the period.
reproSteps: Sign in as the fixture Saleor admin and open a warehouse detail page with Public Stock selected.
Read the descriptions under Pickup availability > Local stock only and All warehouses.
bugs.reason: Rejected for the pinned Saleor dashboard fixture (source commit a6e7bee68ab183147ec680e03e86c29f717a11d5): both description renderers replace the message break placeholder with a br element. With Public Stock selected in a fresh fixture browser, Local stock only and All warehouses visibly separated pickup point. from Ordered products with a line break. The reported run-together sentences were not reproduced; concatenated text without the rendered line break does not establish this claim.
